class ToxicDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, tokenizer, max_len=512):
        self.df = df
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_len = max_len
        self.ids = df["id"].tolist()
        self.comments = df["comment_text"].tolist()
        self.labels = df[
            ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]
        ].values.tolist()

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.comments)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        id_ = self.ids[idx]
        comment = self.comments[idx]
        label = self.labels[idx]

        # Tokenize
        encoded = self.tokenizer.encode_plus(
            comment, add_special_tokens=True, truncation=True, padding="max"
        )
        input_ids = torch.tensor(encoded["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long).unsqueeze(0)
        attention_mask = torch.tensor(
            encoded["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
        ).unsqueeze(0)

        return {
            "ids": [id_],
            "labels": label,
            "input_ids": input_ids,
            "attention_mask": attention_mask,
        }
